script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mercury is officially going retrograde in your 7th House of Partnerships, creating a tense opposition to your fiery Aries Sun. Meanwhile, your ruling planet Mars sits quietly in your 4th House, asking your Fire element to warm the home before you rush out into the cold chaos.

If you are taken, a misunderstood text message today could reopen a conversation about commitment you thought was closed. If single, expect a familiar face from your past to knock on your door seeking deep emotional clarity.

Venus transits your 6th House of Daily Work, signaling a perfect window to negotiate a raise or finalize a project contract before noon strikes.

Warning: Do not sign any document today under the heavy Mercury shadow, or you will rewrite the painful terms later. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
